headline: Contested Sectors Hold as Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the last edition, Linn Mercy has become a sharper danger point, its daily ledger rising to 20 strategic-base events, with six in the latest two hours and the line divided six Warden bases to five Colonial. Weathered Expanse remains the war’s busiest district at 54 events, still split four Warden to five Colonial, though its latest two-hour activity has eased to three events. Stlican Shelf’s current tally stands at 47 events, with three Warden and six Colonial bases; the heavy fighting there has gone quiet in the latest watch. Stonecradle records 25 events and remains closely divided, five Warden to four Colonial, but likewise shows no fresh movement in two hours. Godcrofts has 22 events and no recent action, while Fisherman’s Row has erupted most recently, posting eight events in two hours and 11 across the day amid a seven-Warden, one-Colonial, one-neutral disposition. Callahan’s Passage and Marban Hollow remain active in the broader ledger, but neither reports movement in the latest two-hour window. The war remains without a declared victor.
